## Notes / Thoughts
Fed the sourdough starter with rye flour this morning, it doubled by lunch. Bulk fermentation for the loaf took six hours in the cold kitchen and the oven spring was weak, probably overproofed. Also ran an easy ten kilometres keeping heart rate low and watered the monstera, the soil was still wet so I skipped it. Need to look at [[Sourdough starter]] notes again and practise barre chords tonight for twenty minutes with the metronome.
